publishedProjects.name: Sacred Interval · Church of Dissociation
publishedProjects.description: A publicly accessible reading and exploration site with philosophical texts, interpretation, consent and community-oriented materials. The website is live; this does not establish legal institutional status, treatment credentials or verified real-world gatherings.
publishedProjects.dateLabel: Public website checked; wider community status unverified

publishedProjects.name: Porchbraid
publishedProjects.description: An ad-free social network with a chronological friends feed, community forums and private messaging. Earlier releases used the names Goodfolk and FriendLynk.

publishedProjects.name: Traffic With Intent
publishedProjects.description: An interstate trading game set in 49 cities. Start in Sanford, study fictional markets, hire a road partner and build a business. The Midnight Press edition adds three collectible covers.
publishedProjects.dateLabel: Public web release v21 · game edition 15.0

project-artificial-continuity.description: An open-source workspace for preserving project context, decisions and selected handoffs. The main repository documents version 0.22.1.

project-total-recall-mindvault-echolens.description: A voice journal for Android and Linux Mint. It pairs original audio with a transcript, a review inbox and desktop capture. The public field guide explains the 0.22 series.

project-rhymemosaic.description: The v72 public poetry site separates estimated writing dates from posting evidence and includes a recorded performance in title search and its Media tab. The v44 release verified Copy + link and TXT controls. Mobile visual acceptance remains separate.

project-hydra-index.description: An evidence-conscious compound and research reference. Its current public health endpoint reports release 67529258 ready. Source-linked study reading, the Observatory and research discovery remain its central public routes.

project-threads-observatory.description: A private editorial workspace for poems, phrases, definitions and post-performance history. Its review queue keeps draft and published states distinct.

project-resonance-atlas-synchronicity.description: An owner-only workspace for recording coincidences, examining patterns and comparing interpretations. Its current site record reports v9. Recorded experiences are not treated as proof of causality.

project-public-deception-atlas.description: An owner-only source-linked research project about public claims, documented misrepresentation and counterevidence. The current site record reports v15; its private case material is not exposed through this directory.

project-forge-lexicon.description: The language-development pipeline keeps experiments, exact usage witnesses and reviewed definitions distinct. The private reconciliation retains 203 public term records and 313 definition versions while collecting 43 candidate forms and 10 source witnesses. These overlapping counts are not additive unique-word totals; new candidates are not automatically published.
project-forge-lexicon.dateLabel: Private reconciliation updated; all earlier definitions preserved

project-brandonmeant.description: A poetry collection arranged in seven rows and seven columns. A revised 82-page reading proof is under author review for artwork, typography and facing-page navigation. Retail and physical-proof acceptance remain open.

project-the-wreckage-arranged-me.description: The companion volume to BRANDONMEANT has a full reading candidate. Artwork and print production remain under review.

project-sanford-resource-hub.description: A mobile guide to local support in Sanford and Lee County, with a price board, savings resources and printable materials. Check the date and source of a listing before making a trip.

project-techenlight.description: Public technology services covering device troubleshooting, websites, practical AI and one-to-one tutoring. Its project section now also links directly to the public Sanford Resource Hub; that connection was independently checked.
project-techenlight.dateLabel: Public service website and Sanford cross-link checked

concepts.name: DAB-1 · Prompting Benchmark
concepts.description: A retained prompting-comparison experiment with prepared pilot materials. No completed empirical run, measured advantage or validated outcome is claimed.

concepts.name: Eliminating Loneliness · Teaching Pilot
concepts.description: A retained teaching and connection-oriented pilot idea. Lesson recovery and a small, testable pilot would precede any claim of delivery or demonstrated benefit.

concepts.name: Burrit’o’clock
concepts.description: A playful product idea kept in the speculative backlog. Its presence here records an idea worth retaining, not an available product or a promise to build it.

concepts.name: Public-interest Creative & Technical Lab
concepts.description: A possible supporter-funded framework for documented creative and technical work. Funding, institutional status, staffing and delivered fellowships are not established.

now.title: Poetry, easier to carry
now.text: The poem toolbar has Copy + link and one-click TXT. Keep the words alone, or take their title, author and source link with them.

now.title: Play the interstate market
now.text: Start a run in Sanford, hire a road partner and see how far your opening cash will take you.

now.title: Find your circle
now.text: Follow friends in chronological order or join a conversation in the community forums.

now.title: Words in development
now.text: The newest lexical candidates are consolidated privately; existing public words and definition history remain intact. Proposed meanings are not final entries.

now.title: Beyond finished products
now.text: Four retained concepts remain visible alongside public sites, prototypes and historical work. An idea belongs on the map without pretending it has launched.

boundaries: Public-facing metadata only. No private app URLs, raw conversations, manuscripts, credentials or medical/legal records.
A review date is not a creation date. Host release records are not claims of full device acceptance.
Public website availability does not establish institutional status, professional credentials, community activity or the truth of every claim on that website.
Ideas remain concepts until implementation and deployment are independently established.
No new dictionary entry, poem or private source document is published by this reconciliation.
